relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that EA suppresses SNL-induced neuropathic pain by improving synaptic plasticity via upregulation of bFGF expression.

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that EA improved synaptic plasticity, consistent with higher levels of expression of bFGF and VEGF.

relationships.subject: NSC37204
relationships.evidence_quote: NSC37204 (a specific inhibitor of bFGF) was used to determine the relationship between bFGF and putative EA-mediated improvements in synaptic plasticity.

relationships.subject: bFGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Evidence has suggested that basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) plays an important role in promoting nerve regeneration and can promote the expression of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF).

key_findings: Electroacupuncture improved synaptic plasticity and relieved SNL-induced hyperalgesia with higher bFGF and VEGF.
The bFGF inhibitor NSC37204 blocked EA benefits and lowered bFGF and VEGF.
